scores.evidence: "Correlation IDs on both sides; PHI-scrubbed logs to SIEM; latency, error, lag, and diff dashboard; on-call alerts"

scores.rationale: Failure handling appears in every phase, from fallback and PITR through DLQs, singleton guard, rollback rehearsal, and DR failover.
